note: Every entry is a freely redistributable homebrew build committed to a public repository. No commercial ROMs are hosted here. Covers are real 240x160 frames captured from the running emulator.

games.title: Alien Invasion
games.author: amberephraim
games.description: A fixed-screen space shooter: aliens descend in waves while your cannon picks them off from below. Written in C against the bare GBA hardware renderer.

games.title: Cyber Citadel
games.author: amberephraim
games.description: A neon-soaked side-scroller with hand-drawn title art and painted scenery. The heaviest ROM in the library at 9.5 MB, streamed only when you launch it.

games.title: Simple Frogger
games.author: amberephraim
games.description: A homebrew lane-crosser: dodge the traffic, thread the gaps, reach the far bank. Sixty frames of pure arcade timing.
